name: @meldframe/web-export
description: The Export section of the inspector and the Export dialog of the web client: HTML (Tailwind or plain CSS) with the report of what the export could not carry, and PNG at 1x and 2x. It draws `state.export` of the app layer and dispatches actions; which frame can be exported, the document and the report are the app layer's. Used as source by apps/web.
